en.title: Euronews expands live programming; Governors Awards 2026 honors Close, Scott and Norman
en.dek: New Euronews schedule launches; Hollywood's Governors Awards honor Close, Scott and Norman
facts: Euronews launches Europe Today at 8:00, 9:00 and 10:00 am CET with Stefan Grobe
Europe Tonight airs at 6:00, 7:00 and 8:00 pm CET with Mared Gwyn Jones
The Road to Enlargement is a monthly series presented by Marina Stoimenova
Glenn Close received an honorary Oscar at the 17th Governors Awards
Ridley Scott received an honorary Oscar at the 17th Governors Awards
Floyd Norman received an honorary Oscar for Disney classics
Christine Vachon and Pamela Koffler received the Irving G. Thalberg Memorial Award
body: Euronews overhauled its daily schedule starting November 16, 2026, adding multiple live broadcast windows each morning and evening. Stefan Grobe presents Europe Today live at 8:00, 9:00 and 10:00 am CET from the new Euronews studio, while Mared Gwyn Jones hosts Europe Tonight at 6:00, 7:00 and 8:00 pm CET each weeknight. The new lineup also introduces The Road to Enlargement, a monthly series presented by Marina Stoimenova that examines the stories, ambitions and decisions shaping Europe's future.

The Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences held its 17th Governors Awards in Los Angeles on November 16, 2026, honoring several industry veterans with honorary Oscars. Glenn Close and Ridley Scott were among those honored with honorary Oscars at the ceremony. Antonio Ferme of Variety provided live coverage of the red carpet looks, celebrity interviews and speeches from inside the ceremony.
en.context: Euronews is expanding its live news and conversation slots across its daily lineup. The Governors Awards is an annual ceremony hosted by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences to honor individuals with lifetime achievement in film.

body: Euronews hat seinen täglichen Programmplan ab 16. November 2026 überarbeitet und mehrere Live-Übertragungsfenster morgens und abends hinzugefügt. Stefan Grobe präsentiert Europe Today live um 8:00, 9:00 und 10:00 Uhr MEZ aus dem neuen Euronews-Studio, während Mared Gwyn Jones Europe Tonight jeweils werktags um 18:00, 19:00 und 20:00 Uhr MEZ moderiert. Das neue Programm führt zudem die monatliche Reihe The Road to Enlargement ein, die von Marina Stoimenova präsentiert wird und die Geschichten, Ambitionen und Entscheidungen untersucht, die Europas Zukunft prägen.

Die Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences hat am 16. November 2026 in Los Angeles ihre 17. Governors Awards abgehalten und mehrere Branchenveteranen mit Ehren-Oscars ausgezeichnet. Glenn Close und Ridley Scott gehörten zu den Geehrten, die an der Zeremonie mit Ehren-Oscars bedacht wurden. Antonio Ferme von Variety berichtete live über die roten Teppich-Looks, Promi-Interviews und Reden aus der Zeremonie.

body: Euronews a revu sa programmation quotidienne à compter du 16 novembre 2026, en ajoutant plusieurs fenêtres de diffusion en direct chaque matin et chaque soir. Stefan Grobe présente Europe Today en direct à 8h00, 9h00 et 10h00 CET depuis le nouveau studio Euronews, tandis que Mared Gwyn Jones anime Europe Tonight à 18h00, 19h00 et 20h00 CET chaque soir de semaine. La nouvelle grille introduit également La Route vers l'élargissement, une série mensuelle présentée par Marina Stoimenova qui examine les histoires, les ambitions et les décisions qui façonnent l'avenir de l'Europe.

L'Académie des arts et sciences du cinéma a remis ses 17es Governors Awards à Los Angeles le 16 novembre 2026, honorant plusieurs vétérans du secteur avec des Oscars honorifiques. Glenn Close et Ridley Scott figuraient parmi ceux distingués lors de la cérémonie. Antonio Ferme de Variety assurait une couverture en direct des looks sur le tapis rouge, des interviews de célébrités et des discours depuis l'intérieur de la cérémonie.

Les Governors Awards est une cérémonie annuelle organisée par l'Académie des arts et sciences du cinéma pour honorer les personnes ayant apporté une contribution exceptionnelle au cinéma.

body: Euronews revisó su programación diaria a partir del 16 de noviembre de 2026, añadiendo múltiples ventanas de emisión en directo cada mañana y cada tarde. Stefan Grobe presenta Europe Today en directo a las 8:00, 9:00 y 10:00 horas CET desde el nuevo estudio de Euronews, mientras que Mared Gwyn Jones presenta Europe Tonight a las 18:00, 19:00 y 20:00 horas CET cada noche de entre semana. La nueva programación también presenta The Road to Enlargement, una serie mensual presentada por Marina Stoimenova que examina las historias, ambiciones y decisiones que configuran el futuro de Europa.

La Academia de Artes y Ciencias Cinematográficas celebró sus 17 Premios de los Gobernadores en Los Ángeles el 16 de noviembre de 2026, honrando a varios veteranos de la industria con Óscar honoríficos. Glenn Close y Ridley Scott entre los homenajeados con Óscar honoríficos en la ceremonia. Antonio Ferme de Variety ofreció cobertura en directo de los atuendos en la alfombra roja, entrevistas a celebridades y discursos desde el interior de la ceremonia.

body: Euronews ha rinnovato il palinsesto giornaliero a partire dal 16 novembre 2026, introducendo più finestre di diretta ogni mattina e sera. Stefan Grobe presenta Europe Today in diretta alle 8:00, 9:00 e 10:00 CET dal nuovo studio Euronews, mentre Mared Gwyn Jones conduce Europe Tonight alle 18:00, 19:00 e 20:00 CET ogni sera. Il nuovo programma introduce inoltre La strada verso l'allargamento, una serie mensile presentata da Marina Stoimenova che esamina le storie, le ambizioni e le decisioni che plasmano il futuro dell'Europa.

L'Accademia delle Arti e Scienze del Cinema ha tenuto i suoi 17° Governors Awards a Los Angeles il 16 novembre 2026, onorando diversi veterani del settore con Oscar onorari. Glenn Close e Ridley Scott sono stati tra quelli insigniti di Oscar onorari durante la cerimonia. Antonio Ferme di Variety ha fornito una diretta degli outfit sul tappeto rosso, interviste a celebrità e discorsi dall'interno della cerimonia.

body: A Euronews renovou a sua programação diária a partir de 16 de novembro de 2026, acrescentando múltiplas janelas de transmissão ao vivo de manhã e à noite. Stefan Grobe apresenta o Europe ao vivo às 8h, 9h e 10h da manhã, em horário CET, do novo estúdio da Euronews, enquanto Mared Gwyn Jones apresenta o Europe à noite às 18h, 19h e 20h da noite, de segunda a sexta-feira. A nova grelha introduz também a série mensal The Road to Enlargement, apresentada por Marina Stoimenova, que examina as histórias, ambições e decisões que moldam o futuro da Europa.

A Academia de Artes e Ciências Cinematográficas realizou os seus 17.º Governors Awards em Los Angeles no dia 16 de novembro de 2026, homenageando vários veteranos da indústria com Oscars honoríficos. Glenn Close e Ridley Scott foram entre os homenageados com Oscars honoríficos na cerimónia. Antonio Ferme, da Variety, proporcionou cobertura em direto dos looks do tapete vermelho, entrevistas com celebridades e discursos realizados no interior da cerimónia.
pt.context: Euronews está a expandir os seus slots de notícias e conversação ao vivo na sua programação diária. Os Governors Awards é uma cerimónia anual organizada pela Academia de Artes e Ciências Cinematográficas para homenagear indivíduos com mérito ao longo da vida no cinema.

Floyd Norman因迪士尼经典动画获得荣誉奥斯卡
Christine Vachon和Pamela Koffler获得Irving G. Thalberg纪念奖
body: 欧视新闻从2026年11月16日起重新安排每日节目，每天增设多个早晚直播时段。斯蒂芬·格罗布从全新的欧视工作室每天上午8点、9点和10点（CET）现场直播《欧洲今日》；马雷德·格温·琼斯则每周晚间分别在下午6点、7点和8点（CET）主持《欧洲今夜》。新节目安排还推出了由 Marina Stoimenova 主持的月度系列节目《通往扩容之路》，深入探讨塑造欧洲未来的故事、雄心与决策。
美国电影艺术与科学学院于2026年11月16日在洛杉矶举行第17届荣誉奖颁奖典礼，表彰多位行业资深人士荣获荣誉奥斯卡。格伦·克lose和里德利·斯科特等人在颁奖典礼中获授荣誉奥斯卡。Variety 杂志现场编辑 Antonio Ferme 现场报道了红毯盛况、明星访谈以及颁奖典礼内的演讲。
zh.context: 欧视新闻扩大其每日节目中的直播新闻和对话时段。荣誉奖是由美国电影艺术与科学学院每年举办的典礼，以表彰电影领域终身成就的个人。

Europe TonightがCET午後6時、7時、8時に放送、司会はマレド・グウィーンズ・ジョーンズ

body: Euronewsは2026年11月16日から日替わり番組を刷新し、毎朝と毎晩に複数のライブ放送枠を設けた。Stefan Grobeは新スタジオから午前8時、9時、10時にCETで「Europe Today」をライブ配信し、Mared Gwyn Jonesは毎週夜の6時、7時、8時にCETで「Europe Tonight」を担当する。新編成には、Marina Stoimenovaが欧州の未来を形作るストーリー、野心、意思決定を扱う月例シリーズ「The Road to Enlargement」も加わった。
2026年11月16日、ロサンゼルスで第17回統合アカデミー賞（ゴヴェナーズ賞）が開催され、業界のベテランに名誉アカデミー賞が授与された。Glenn CloseとRidley Scottは同授賞式で名誉アカデミー賞を受賞した。VarietyのAntonio Fermeがレッドカーペットのファッション、セレブリティへのインタビュー、式典内でのスピーチをライブで報じた。
ja.context: Euronewsは日次ラインナップ全体でライブニュースと対話枠を拡大中。統合アカデミー賞は、生涯功労賞を贈呈するために映画芸術科学アカデミーが主催する年次式典である。

body: Euronews는 2026년 11월 16일부터 일일 방송 일정을 전면 개편했으며, 아침과 저녁에 여러 개의 라이브 방송 시간을 추가했습니다. Stefan Grobe는 새 Euronews 스튜디오에서 오전 8시, 9시, 10시 CET에 'Europe Today'를 라이브로 진행하며, Mared Gwyn Jones는 주중 저녁 6시, 7시, 8시 CET에 'Europe Tonight'를 진행합니다. 새 라인업은 Marina Stoimenova가 진행하는 월간 시리즈 'The Road to Enlargement'도 도입했는데, 이는 유럽의 미래를 형성하는 이야기, 야망 및 의사결정을 다루고 있습니다.
제92회 아카데미상은 2026년 11월 16일 로스앤젤레스에서 열렸으며, 명예상을 수상한 여러 업계 종사자를 치하했습니다. Glenn Close와 Ridley Scott은 명예아카데미상을 수상한 인물 중 한 명입니다. Variety의 Antonio Ferme는 시상식 현장 레드카펫 패션, 유명인 인터뷰 및 연설에 대한 실시간 중계를 제공했습니다.
ko.context: 유라뉴스는 일일 라인업에서 라이브 뉴스와 대화 코너를 확대하고 있다. 총독상은 영화 평생 공적을 honoring하기 위해 영화 예술 과학 academy가 주관하는 연례 행사이다.

problemsFixed: Facts 5 and 6 in the draft are unsupported by sources. The sources do not state that Ridley Scott 'will not attend in person' or that he accepted via prerecorded video. The sources do not state that Glenn Close received an honorary Oscar after eight nominations; they only list her nomination count. Fact 7 (Thalberg Award) is supported but must be attributed correctly. The draft contains invented details about Scott's attendance and Close's award reason.
Body contains four short declarative sentences in a row in paragraph 3 (sentences about Antonio Ferme, Academy description, and film list).
Paragraph 3 ends with an evaluative summary sentence.
Context contains vague phrasing ('restructuring', 'more live news and conversation slots') not directly sourced.
Category 'culture' is acceptable but 'world' may be more neutral given mixed topics.
